findings.title: The Day as sovereign decisive event
findings.claim: The focus phrase can make the Day a decisive event in which divergent courses receive their consequential separation under one sovereign authority.
findings.mechanism: The carrier {ar:مَٰلِكِ, tr:mâliki, gloss:sahibi ve hükmedeni} supplies divine dominion, {ar:يَوْمِ, tr:y evmi, gloss:günün} contacts the event-day facet through the supplied final-separation trigger, and {ar:ٱلدِّينِ, tr:ed-dîni, gloss:hesap ve karşılık düzeninin} judgment facet supplies the accounting operation; together they change a calendar-like day into an authoritative sorting event.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the phrase carries more force than a date: the day is the occasion when different paths become consequentially distinct.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading of the Owner of the Day of Reckoning remains intact. This finding does not specify every final outcome or turn the focus into a complete surah thesis; the severe-event facet is retained as a qualified parallel, not as a replacement for the ordinary day.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding directly anchors all three focus branches and strong connection rows independently echo sovereignty, final separation, and recompense; legacy records are retained as corroborating alternatives rather than used as the foundation.

branch_activations.boundary: This activates the divine-sovereignty facet; it does not activate every ownership or kingship use of the root.
